_fixture_note: Adversarial fixture for coverage scoring, not for area/perimeter. Purpose: the floor surface itself is high confidence (so area/perimeter math is fine), but most walls/doors/windows are low/medium confidence — a coverage score that only looks at the floor's own confidence field would report this capture as fully usable when it isn't. Same 4.20x3.10 rectangle as the single-room fixture so area/perimeter assertions can be reused if needed.
